chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Kidnapping from India.
text: Whoever conveys any person beyond the limits of [1][India] without the consent of that person, or of some person legally authorised to consent on behalf of that person, is said to kidnap that person from [1][India].
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.by_ref_raw: A. O. 1948, the A. O. 1950 and Act 3 of 1951
amendment_history.footnote_text: The words “British India” have successively been subs. by the A. O. 1948, the A. O. 1950 and Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Sch., to read as above.
